decisive_items: heterozygous mutation (c.754G>A, p.A252T) in the HTRA1 gene
lacunar infarctions and periventricular white matter hyperintensities (WMH)
multiple cerebral microbleeds (CMBs) and relatively fewer CMBs in deep regions, mainly involving bilateral parieto-occipital lobes
response.rationale: R2 directly matches the raw genetic span identifying an HTRA1 mutation, which is pathognomonic for HTRA1-related cerebral small vessel disease. R5 incorrectly attributes the HTRA1 mutation to CADASIL, a contradiction. R1 and R3 rely on non-specific CMB patterns and lack the genetic specificity of R2.

rejected.why: Raw span shows HTRA1 mutation, not NOTCH3, contradicting CADASIL.
CAA is not supported by the HTRA1 mutation; lacks genetic specificity.
HCHWA is not supported by the HTRA1 mutation; lacks genetic specificity.
